notes.title: Macaron Sickness – Video & Streaming Guidelines
notes.notes:
[p][b]\[About Streaming Guidelines][/b]
[i]MacaronSickness[/i] is created and managed by independent creator [b]Rita Mizuhara[/b].[/p][p]Both individuals and organizations are welcome to monetize content featuring this title, as long as it follows the official guidelines.
([i]Monetization is limited to content platforms that allow it, such as streaming and video[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Please check the full guidelines at the following URL:[/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1RuUcFro2WmvQTmfA07gWpKhq_z_A1LlibKbXD0Lic0Q/edit?usp=sharing"]https://docs.google.com/document/d/1RuUcFro2WmvQTmfA07gWpKhq_z_A1LlibKbXD0Lic0Q/edit?usp=sharing[/url][/p][p][/p][p]When posting videos or livestreaming, we would appreciate it if you could include the following in your video description:[/p][list][*][p]The tag [b]#MacaSick[/b][/p][/*][*][p]A link to the Steam version of the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689120/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you have any questions regarding the streaming guidelines, feel free to contact us via [b]X (formerly Twitter)[/b] or the method listed in the document.[/p][p][url="https://mizuhararita@gmail.com"]mizuhararita@gmail.com[/url][/p][p]Please note that these guidelines are subject to change upon the official release of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Materials for Streaming Use][/b]
These assets may only be used for [i]MacaronSickness[/i] gameplay videos and livestreams.[/p][p]You are welcome to use them in your videos or thumbnails.[/p][p]All copyrights are owned by [b]Rita Mizuhara[/b].[/p][p][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QG-oF4iNBQzVEwksHP9hLx_lSaWt4dB_?usp=drive_link"]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QG-oF4iNBQzVEwksHP9hLx_lSaWt4dB_?usp=drive_link[/url][/p][p][/p]
